test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

d _ a _ b _ q d h _ a _ c q _ h _ a _ c q

options.text: h a c a b d a b
h a b a b d a b
h a c a b d q b
h a q a b d a b

solution:
Given sequence: d _ a _ b _ q d h _ a _ c q _ h _ a _ c q

 
• h a c a b d a b → d **h** a **a** b **c** q - d h **a** a **b** c q - **d** h **a** a **b** c q
 
• h a b a b d a b → d **h** a **a** b **b** q - d h **a** a **b** c q - **d** h **a** a **b** c q
 
• h a c a b d q b → d **h** a **a** b **c** q - d h **a** a **b** c q - **d** h **q** a **b** c q
 
• h a q a b d a b → d **h** a **a** b **q** q - d h **a** a **b** c q - **d** h **a** a **b** c q

 
• In option 1, dhaabcq is repeated.

Hence, '**h a c a b d a b**' is the correct answer.
